question: What skills do I need to get an entry-level cloud engineer job?
sources:
[1] Cloud Engineer at SAIC (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-19)
As a Cloud Engineer, you will advise mission users on utilizing cloud-based IT systems, provide support for development in, or transition to the cloud, and be responsible for the implementation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of cloud environments.

[2] Business Analyst with DevOps at Best High Technologies LLC (BHT) (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-18)
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Certification in DevOps or related field (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Docker Certified Associate).

[3] DevOps/ Cloud Engineer at Hexagon Safety, Infrastructure & Geospatial (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-18)
As a DevOps/Cloud Engineer you will help harden software solutions supporting divisions going through a technological transformation.
Working in a small group, you’ll guide our development teams through creating and automating their cloud infrastructure , as well as build and maintain the central platform and solutions, which the R&D teams can benefit from.
We are a multi- cloud company (AWS, Azure & GCP), meaning that you will get to apply a diverse mix of tools and services.

[4] Cloud Engineer at LanceSoft, Inc. (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-19)
Cloud engineer to develop cloud-based applications & services, design & implement unstructured cloud data (S3) I/O & processing and optimize engineering data pipelines and implement data security for Product Development and Test Engineering

[5] Cloud Engineer at Brickhouse Resources (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-09)
The Cloud Data Engineer will be responsible for designing and implementing Analytics solutions as part of a team.
